1use crate::{depinfo::DependencyInfo, input::InputFile, output};
2use memchr::{memchr2, memmem};
3use miette::{miette, Context as _, IntoDiagnostic as _, Severity};
4use std::io::{self, BufRead};
5
6enum Check {
7	/// Everything is up to date.
8	UpToDate,
9
10	/// The dependency info is malformed.
11	InvalidDepInfo(miette::Report),
12
13	/// The input (template or rustdoc) have changed.
14	InputChanged,
15
16	/// One or more dependencies use an incompatible version.
17	IncompatibleVersion(String),
18
19	/// The readme used an outdated "markdown version".
20	OutdatedMarkdown,
21
22	/// Input and output are different (no dep info was included).
23	OutputChanged
24}
25
26impl Check {
27	fn to_report(&self) -> miette::Report {
28		match self {
29			Check::UpToDate => {
30				miette!(severity = Severity::Advice, "Readme is up to date")
31			},
32			Check::InvalidDepInfo(e) => {
33				miette!(
34					severity = Severity::Warning,
35					"Readme has invalid dependency info: {e}"
36				)
37			},
38			Check::InputChanged => miette!("Input has changed"),
39			Check::IncompatibleVersion(name) => {
40				miette!("Readme links to incompatible version of dependency `{name}'")
41			},
42			Check::OutdatedMarkdown => {
43				miette!(
44					"The readme was created with an outdated version of cargo doc2readme"
45				)
46			},
47			Check::OutputChanged => {
48				miette!("Readme has changed")
49			}
50		}
51	}
52}
53
54pub fn check_up2date<R: io::Read>(
55	mut input: InputFile,
56	template_filename: &str,
57	template: &str,
58	mut check_file: R
59) -> miette::Result<()> {
60	let mut check_buf = Vec::new();
61	check_file
62		.read_to_end(&mut check_buf)
63		.into_diagnostic()
64		.context("Failed to read existing README from disk")?;
65
66	// the error we will return if the byte-wise comparison failed
67	let mut err = Check::OutputChanged;
68
69	let search_key = " [__cargo_doc2readme_dependencies_info]: ";
70	if let Some(search_idx) = memmem::find(&check_buf, search_key.as_bytes()) {
71		let sub = &check_buf[search_idx + search_key.len() ..];
72		let end_idx = memchr2(b' ', b'\n', sub).unwrap_or(sub.len());
73		let depinfo_str = String::from_utf8(sub[.. end_idx].to_vec()).unwrap();
74		let depinfo = match DependencyInfo::decode(depinfo_str) {
75			Ok(depinfo) => depinfo,
76			Err(e) => return Err(Check::InvalidDepInfo(e).to_report())
77		};
78
79		// ensure the input is up to date
80		if !depinfo.check_input(template, &input.rustdoc) {
81			return Err(Check::InputChanged.to_report());
82		}
83
84		// ensure that the dependencies that were used in the readme still meet the current required
85		// versions. dependencies that are missing in the readme don't matter.
86		for (lib_name, dep) in &input.dependencies {
87			if !depinfo.check_dependency(&dep.crate_name, Some(&dep.req), lib_name, true)
88			{
89				return Err(
90					Check::IncompatibleVersion(dep.crate_name.clone()).to_report()
91				);
92			}
93		}
94
95		// ensure markdown version matches
96		if depinfo.check_outdated() {
97			// update the input: we want to use exactly the same dependencies
98			for (krate, version) in depinfo.dependency_list() {
99				if let Some(dep) = input.dependencies.get_mut(krate) {
100					dep.version = version.clone();
101				}
102			}
103			// now, error if the output mismatches later
104			err = Check::OutdatedMarkdown;
105		}
106		// looks like everything is up to date
107		else {
108			return Err(Check::UpToDate.to_report());
109		}
110	}
111
112	// if no dependency info was available, first render the readme
113	let mut output_buf = Vec::new();
114	output::emit(&input, template_filename, template, &mut output_buf).unwrap();
115
116	// then filter out the [__cargo_doc2readme_dependencies_info] line
117	let filter_depinfo = move |buf: &[u8]| -> String {
118		buf.lines()
119			.map(|line| line.unwrap())
120			.filter(|line| !line.starts_with(search_key))
121			.collect::<Vec<_>>()
122			.join("\n")
123	};
124	let output_str = filter_depinfo(&output_buf);
125	let check_str = filter_depinfo(&check_buf);
126
127	// and finally do a string comparison
128	if output_str == check_str {
129		err = Check::UpToDate;
130	}
131	Err(err.to_report())
132}
